tool_input.command:
t=$(mktemp -d); mkdir -p "$t/src"; echo hi > "$t/src/f.txt"
for i in 1 2 3 4 5; do BACKUP_STAMP=2026010$i-120000 bash backup.sh --quiet --dest "$t/dest" --name demo "$t/src" >/dev/null; done
echo "--- dry-run, keep 2 of 5:"
bash rotate.sh --dest "$t/dest" --name demo --keep=2 --dry-run
echo "--- real run, keep 2 of 5:"
bash rotate.sh --dest "$t/dest" --name demo --keep 2
echo "--- remaining archives and sidecars:"
(cd "$t/dest" && ls | paste -sd' ' -)
echo "--- help exits 0:"; bash rotate.sh --help >/dev/null; echo "rc=$?"
echo "--- unknown option:"; bash rotate.sh --dest "$t/dest" --name demo --bogus 2>/dev/null; echo "rc=$?"
rm -rf "$t"
tool_input.description: Manually test rotate.sh rotation, dry-run, and option handling
Remove scratch scripts and show changed files

result:
`git status` needs approval in this permission mode, so I'll skip it — I have the exact list of files I touched, and the full suite passed (9/9) after the last repository edit.

Summary of the work:

- **`rotate.sh`** — fixed the off-by-one in the rotation window: `total -lt keep` → `total -le keep` (exactly N backups now stops with "nothing to rotate"), and `surplus` now selects the *oldest* `total - keep` entries (`head -n "$((total - keep))"`) instead of `tail -n +"$keep"` which selected the newest. Replaced its copy of the option parser and `resolve_dir` with `source lib/common.sh`; all flags (`--dest`, `--name`, `--keep`, `--keep=N`, `-n/--dry-run`, `-q/--quiet`, `-h`) behave as before.
- **`verify.sh`** — split the sidecar line with `read -r expected file` instead of `awk '{print $2}'`, which truncated names at the first space; also quoted the digest comparison. Same parser/`resolve_dir` refactor into `source lib/common.sh`.
- **`lib/common.sh`** (new) — the shared option-parsing block, `is_uint`, `need_value`, `--keep` validation, and `resolve_dir`, with the same double-source guard convention as `lib/log.sh`; callers supply `usage` and `parse_local_option`.
- **`tests/run_tests.sh`** — added a verify test for an intact archive named `my backup-20260101-000000.tar.gz` (expects `ok` + rc 0) and a rotate group that builds exactly 3 archives and runs `--keep 3` (expects zero deletions and all three, newest included, present).

`backup.sh`, `restore.sh`, and `report.sh` are untouched.

Changed: `rotate.sh`, `verify.sh`, `tests/run_tests.sh`, and added `lib/common.sh`.
